name: bare-module-lexer
description: Heuristic lexer for detecting imports and exports in JavaScript modules

exports.name: lex
exports.description: Lex `input` for import and export statements, returning the detected `imports` and `exports`.

params.name: input
params.description: The source to lex, as a string or buffer.

params.name: encoding
params.description: The encoding of `input` when it is a string.

throws.condition: `input` is not a string or buffer.

members.name: lex.constants
signatures:
lex.constants: {
    REQUIRE: number
    IMPORT: number
    DYNAMIC: number
    ADDON: number
    ASSET: number
    RESOLVE: number
    REEXPORT: number
  }

exports.name: Import
exports.description: An import detected in the source. `type` is a combination of the `lex.constants` flags (e.g. `REQUIRE`, `IMPORT`, `DYNAMIC`); `position` holds the offsets `[importStart, specifierStart, specifierEnd]`.

members.name: position
signatures: position: [importStart: number, specifierStart: number, specifierEnd: number]

exports.name: Export
exports.description: An export detected in the source; `position` holds the offsets `[exportStart, nameStart, nameEnd]`.

members.name: position
signatures: position: [exportStart: number, nameStart: number, nameEnd: number]
